node: Solid rocket motor energetics and missile-production inputs
summary: Layer 1B expands the public universe around solid rocket motor energetics and missile-production inputs. The strongest underfollowed chokepoint lead is NewMarket via American Pacific ammonium perchlorate capacity. Karman and Park Aerospace add component/material adjacency through SRM nozzles, cases, and ablative materials. L3Harris is retained only as a reference demand-path anchor because Aerojet Rocketdyne is one of the major SRM producers and is actively scaling rocket-motor testing and production infrastructure.
